Hi Nora / Aaron —

Great to (virtually) meet you. Thanks for selecting Redwood for the HelixAI evaluation — excited to get the MAP in motion. I wanted to kick off the mutual action plan for the evaluation and align on the security/compliance workstream and POCs.

Quick context: HelixAI has requested a short evaluation focused on inference latency and data handling. As part of procurement, we typically collect SOC 2 artifacts and a handful of evidence items to validate controls. We suggest setting up a 30-minute intake call to confirm the scope and share the MAP template.

Roles on our side:
- Diego Fernandez — Sales lead / contract coordination
- Soojin Lee — GRC / evidence collection PM
- Priyom Das — Technical ops (evidence ingestion, access)

To move quickly, can you confirm the HelixAI POC for security/GRC and the primary data handling contact?

Suggested next steps:
1) Intake call (30 mins) to confirm scope and artifact list — options below
2) HelixAI uploads initial artifacts to a shared folder (SOC 2 report, system description, data-flow diagram, vendor list)
3) Redwood reviews and flags gaps; follow-up doc requests or clarifications
4) Closure or remediation plan in week 3–4 depending on gaps

My availability next week: Tue 2/24 9–11am PT, Wed 2/25 1–3pm PT. If those don't work, send two times that do.

Attaching: redwood-map-template.xlsx (MAP timeline + evidence checklist) — please use this as the center of truth for milestone dates.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

Hi Nora / Aaron —

Thanks for the quick reply and for looping Aaron + Meena in. Short note on how we typically run the GRC/evidence track so expectations are aligned:

What we’ll need (typical artifact set):
- SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter (if applicable)
- System description / high-level architecture (1–2 pages)
- Data flow diagram (sensitive vs. non-sensitive classification called out)
- Data retention & deletion policies for inference inputs/outputs
- Encryption (at rest/in transit) and key management details
- Access control / IAM model and recent access reviews
- List of subservice vendors and any SOC reports for those vendors

I dropped a shared evidence collection folder here for HelixAI: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-Redwood-HelixAI-evidence — please upload initial artifacts there and we’ll ingest them into our review tracker. If there are constraints (e.g., a clearance process for the SOC file), let us know and we can accept download links or an SFTP exchange.

Suggested MAP timeline (we can tighten as needed):
- Week 0: Intake call + confirm scope and list (30 min)
- Week 1: HelixAI uploads initial artifacts to shared folder
- Week 2: Redwood review + targeted follow-up questions
- Week 3: Final clarifications and remediation actions (if any)

If this sounds good, pick 2 times that work for the intake call. Priyom will be on the call to confirm how we’ll ingest artifacts and what file naming conventions we prefer.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
GRC Program Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
